The firm announced that interest reference rates used to calculate long-term debt fair value will be updated monthly rather than daily effective 10 November 2025 due to reduced market volatility; this procedural change does not affect the debt-at-par NAV. These NAVs are the latest per-share valuations relevant to discount/premium and market pricing considerations.
